name: akinaza-monorepo
description: Akinaza — the all-in-one for independent Québec shops: bookings, Loi 25 client files, bilingual invoices with GST/QST, a tax ledger, the GST/QST return prepared for the merchant.

scripts.lint: turbo run lint && pnpm run check:i18n && ast-grep test --skip-snapshot-tests && node scripts/sg-ratchet.mjs && node scripts/deps.mjs
scripts.test:coverage: turbo run test --filter='!./apps/mobile' -- --coverage.enabled --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=lcov && turbo run test --filter='./apps/mobile' && vitest run --coverage.enabled --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=lcov
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.dev:check: turbo run lint typecheck test --filter='...[origin/main]' && vitest run

author: Krizaka
